# incusos_system_storage_pool (Resource)

Manages an IncusOS local ZFS storage pool (`/1.0/system/storage` and `:delete-pool`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `devices` (List of String) List of device IDs (e.g., `/dev/disk/by-id/...`) forming the pool.
- `name` (String) Storage pool name. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `type` (String) ZFS pool topology (`zfs-raid0`, `zfs-raid1`, `zfs-raid10`, `zfs-raidz1`, `zfs-raidz2`, `zfs-raidz3`). Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `alignment` (Number) Sector alignment size in bytes (power of two, defaults to 4096). Can only be set on creation.
- `allow_mixed_dev_sizes` (Boolean) Allow creating a pool with devices of different sizes.
- `cache` (List of String) Optional list of cache (L2ARC) device IDs.
- `log` (List of String) Optional list of log (SLOG) device IDs.
- `special` (Attributes) Optional ZFS special vdev configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--special))

### Read-Only

- `encryption_key_status` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `managed` (Boolean)
- `pool_allocated_space_in_bytes` (Number)
- `raw_pool_size_in_bytes` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `usable_pool_size_in_bytes` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--special"></a>
### Nested Schema for `special`

Required:

- `devices` (List of String) Physical devices for the special vdev.
- `type` (String) Special vdev topology (`zfs-raid0`, `zfs-raid1`, etc.).

Optional:

- `special_small_blocks_size_in_kb` (Number) Threshold in KB for storing small blocks on the special vdev.
